# TidyHaus Home Cleaning

> House, condo, Airbnb, deep, move-in/move-out and office cleaning in Makati and BGC (Taguig), Metro Manila, Philippines. Starting prices are shown online. Customers see an estimated price and send a request in about 2 minutes at https://tidyhausph.com/book; TidyHaus confirms the final price before payment.

- Address: 21st Floor, Rockwell Center, 8 Rockwell Dr, Makati City, 1210 Metro Manila
- Phone, WhatsApp and Viber: +63 992 309 5621
- Hours: 8 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Sunday
- Payment: GCash, Maya or bank transfer (InstaPay / QR Ph). A 25% deposit reserves the date (full amount if booking less than 24 hours ahead); the rest is paid before the visit
- Cancellation: free 24+ hours before (deposit refunded or kept as credit; one free date change). Less than 24 hours before or no one home: the deposit is not refunded. Full terms: https://tidyhausph.com/terms-of-service
- Areas: Makati and BGC; other parts of Metro Manila have a ₱200 travel fee per visit

## Prices per visit (regular cleaning)
- Studio ₱1,300 · 1 bedroom ₱1,500 · 2 bedrooms ₱1,900 · 3 bedrooms ₱2,500
- Deep cleaning from ₱1,900 · Move-in/move-out from ₱2,500
- Office cleaning: small (up to 50 sq m) ₱1,500 · medium (50 to 150 sq m) ₱2,500 · large (over 150 sq m) ₱3,800
- Regular customers: ₱100 off weekly visits, ₱50 off every-2-weeks visits
- First-time customers: ₱200 off with code FIRSTCLEAN
- Refer a friend: ₱200 off for the friend's first cleaning and ₱100 off the referrer's next cleaning; every 10th cleaning ₱500 off; weekly or every-2-weeks customers can prepay 4 visits and save 5% more; customers can ask for the same cleaner
- Same-day booking: until 12 noon, start at least 2 hours away, paid in full
- Party cleaning (before or after a party): same price as deep cleaning
- Aircon cleaning per unit: window ₱800; split ₱1,500 with the outdoor unit (only when reachable from a balcony or service area), ₱1,200 indoor only; inverter or over 1.5HP +₱200
- Sofa, mattress and carpet cleaning (shampoo, steam, dry): 2-seater ₱1,500, 3-seater ₱2,200, 4-seater ₱2,900, 5-seater ₱3,600, 6-seater ₱4,200; chairs ₱500 to ₱1,200; mattress single ₱1,000, double ₱1,800, queen ₱2,400, king ₱3,000; carpet small ₱1,000, medium ₱1,800, large ₱2,800, wall-to-wall ₱40 per sq ft; pet bed ₱600; minimum ₱2,000 per booking
- Add-ons: inside fridge, oven or cabinets ₱300 each; pet hair cleanup (fur on sofas, beds and pillows; floors already included) ₱200; organizing and decluttering ₱300 per hour
- Airbnb & rental cleaning includes linen change (host's linens), restocking guest supplies, and a check for left items or damage

## What's included
- Same 19-point checklist every regular visit (35 points for deep cleaning), before-and-after photos, and a free re-clean within 12 hours if anything on the checklist is missed.
